summary: {person} checks who else stayed on the old rate when the city's minimum rose.
realLife: One Denver complaint about an unchanged hourly rate led analysts to five more workers with the same shortfall.
gates: The worker's recorded rate falls below a newly effective local minimum.
weights: Use of a common pay scale puts other workers on the same rate.
inGame: needs: the rate change date and the hourly rates workers received.

turns.pulledBy: Other workers received the increase on time.

turns.what: Some workers received the increase late.
